name: Rolling Stone Cylinder Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

disable: DC 25 Thievery check check to create a wedge to immobilize the column, DC 21 Athletics check check to immobilize the column until the end of the creature's next turn, a creature can Climb over an Immobilized column with a successful DC 18 Athletics check check.
routine: (1 action) The rolling stone cylinder trap uses Crushing Roll.

items.name: Drop and Roll
items.text:
A lever at the top of the south tower is pulled

---

Effect A thick column of stone drops from above the gate, then uses crushing roll. The rolling stone cylinder trap rolls initiative.

items.name: Crushing Roll
items.text:
Requirements The rolling stone cylinder is not Immobilized

---

Effect The rolling stone cylinder trap moves its Speed west along the bridge. Creatures it moves past or lands on take 5d6 bludgeoning damage and are forced to move west to the first available space (DC 27 basic Reflex save). Creatures who critically succeed at the Reflex save are not damaged but are still moved west. If the rolling stone tries to move into a non-creature obstruction, such as a wall or barricade, it deals bludgeoning damage to the obstruction and only continues moving if the obstruction is destroyed, otherwise the trap stops.

text: A 10-foot-long, 5-foot-thick column of stone thuds to the ground, just in front of the bridge. It immediately starts to roll down the bridge, quickly picking up speed.
